description: This PHP source file defines the ProjectService class within the OrangeHRM Time plugin. It provides methods for managing project activities, including retrieving DAOs, validating project activity names for duplication, and converting project activities into associative maps. It is part of the service layer of the application dealing with project-related business logic.

classes.name: ProjectService
classes.description: Service class that manages project activities, including validation and data transformation related to project activities within the HR system.

methods.name: getProjectDao
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ProjectDao, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getProjectActivityDao
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ProjectActivityDao, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: validateProjectActivityName
methods.description: Validates that project activities from one project do not conflict with or duplicate activities in another project; throws exceptions if validation fails.

methods.name: getProjectActivityAsMap
methods.description: Transforms an array of ProjectActivity entities into an associative array keyed by activity name.
